title: OSPC: Detecting Harmful Memes with Large Language Model as a Catalyst

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying multimodal memes using an LLM pipeline (combining image captioning, OCR, and text) prompted to identify stereotypes or prejudices based on race or ethnicity by calculating the logit probabilities of 'Yes'/'No' tokens.

Classifying multimodal memes using an LLM pipeline prompted to identify content that mocks or demeans specific religions or religious practices by calculating the logit probabilities of 'Yes'/'No' tokens.
Classifying multimodal memes using an LLM pipeline prompted to identify negative stereotypes or biases about different sexual orientations by calculating the logit probabilities of 'Yes'/'No' tokens.

Classifying multimodal memes using an LLM pipeline prompted to identify xenophobia, negative attitudes towards migrants, or glorification of extreme nationalistic views by calculating the logit probabilities of 'Yes'/'No' tokens.
Classifying multimodal memes using an LLM pipeline prompted to identify ridicule of class struggles and socio-economic disparities by calculating the logit probabilities of 'Yes'/'No' tokens.
Classifying multimodal memes using an LLM pipeline prompted to identify stereotypes or biases based on a person's age by calculating the logit probabilities of 'Yes'/'No' tokens.
Classifying multimodal memes using an LLM pipeline prompted to identify gender stereotypes or discrimination based on gender by calculating the logit probabilities of 'Yes'/'No' tokens.

Classifying multimodal memes using an LLM pipeline prompted to identify content that mocks or belittles individuals with illnesses or disabilities by calculating the logit probabilities of 'Yes'/'No' tokens.
